newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta rates start week slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Malta rates start week slightly higher.

text.p: One month and three month interest rates started the week slightly higher on the Maltese money market on Monday.

The Malta Central Bank said the one-week repo rate was unchanged from the previous week at 5.010 percent, but the yield on one-month treasury bills was up to 4.999 percent from 4.996 percent the previous week.
The yield on three-month repos passed the five percent mark, reaching 5.005 from 4.997 the previous week.
Six-month and one-year bills were unchanged at 5.288 percent and 5.360 percent respectively.
